messages:
Tara: quick update — vendor just confirmed delay on APAC baremetal handoff; they need a firmware hold for safety checks. this overlaps with Friday's stress test.
Ken: how long is the hold? can we still run a reduced test?
Tara: vendor said 2.5h window for flash + validation. they asked for signed access window and a bastion jump.
Diego: impact calc: apac-burst pool loses 8 A100s for that window. our canary planned to use 5. we can either borrow or scale down.
Ken: EU standby can only lend 2 (they're mid-maint). US-west has spare 4 but needs a quick quota bump to reach 12 for the session.
Tara: filed reservation: RES-20344 for +4 GPUs in us-west starting 2026-04-02T02:00Z for 3h. infra-bot, ping approvers.
infra-bot: Reservation RES-20344 created | region=us-west | gpus=+4 | window=2026-04-02T02:00Z-05:00Z | priority=high | approvers=@finance,@allocs. ETA approval ~2h.
Diego: fallback if approval delayed: reduce concurrent workers 5->3 and enable KV-prefix warmup to keep latency in SLO.
Ken: also note QA needs DNS TTL lowered to 30s and certs reissued if we move canary region. add that to the checklist.
Tara: Ken, can you post a tiny terraform snippet so Diego can prep the PR? will merge after approval.
Ken: paste this minimal patch: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "temp_burst" {
  region    = "us-west1"
  gpu_count = 4
  labels    = { purpose = "temp-stress" }
}
```
Diego: perfect, i'll open PR with var override and link vault path for node creds. will tag @security on the access-window email once Sofia drafts it.
VendorOps: we can accept remote flash if bastion is reachable and signed access window is provided. onsite still option if remote fails.
infra-bot: RES-20344 status=awaiting_approval. Approvers notified.
Tara: if approval doesn't arrive within 75m, we gate the full stress test and run a reduced smoke. Diego, can you also add an infra ticket for "vendor-firmware-visibility"? recurring pain.
Diego: filing INFRA-3209 now and linking here.
Ken: PR queued; i'll merge once RES-20344 flips to approved — tagging here on merge.
Tara: thanks all. drop :rotating_light: if anything blocks.
